services.title: Wedding Shoot
services.description: A complete visual story of your wedding, from preparations and rituals to the reception. We balance candid emotion, family portraits, couple direction, and detail photography.
services.deliverables: Candid coverage, family portraits, couple portraits, rituals, edited gallery, and album-ready selections.

services.title: Pre-Wedding Shoot
services.description: Relaxed, location-based sessions built around your chemistry and personality. We help with concepts, styling, locations, and natural posing.
services.deliverables: Concept planning, location guidance, edited portraits, cinematic frames, and social-media reels.

services.title: Cinematic Videography
services.description: Story-led wedding and event films with thoughtful camera movement, clean sound, emotional pacing, and polished editing.
services.deliverables: Teaser film, highlight edit, full-event coverage options, reels, and music-synced storytelling.

services.title: Maternity Photography
services.description: Gentle portraits that celebrate pregnancy with soft light, comfortable direction, and intimate family moments.
services.deliverables: Wardrobe guidance, location or home session, individual portraits, couple portraits, and edited keepsakes.

services.title: Outdoor Sessions
services.description: Natural-light portraits designed around golden hour, meaningful locations, scenic backdrops, and an easy-going experience.
services.deliverables: Location planning, creative direction, natural posing, edited gallery, and print-ready images.

services.title: Event Coverage
services.description: Reliable coverage for birthdays, engagements, anniversaries, cultural celebrations, and corporate gatherings.
services.deliverables: Guest moments, decor and details, group portraits, candid reactions, and a curated final gallery.

services.title: Candid Photography
services.description: Unobtrusive photography focused on genuine expressions, laughter, tears, movement, and the moments people often miss.
services.deliverables: Natural storytelling, reaction photography, candid portraits, and carefully edited high-resolution images.

services.title: Modeling Portfolios
services.description: Portfolio sessions that present your personality and range with clear direction, considered lighting, and strong visual framing.
services.deliverables: Mood-board planning, pose direction, outfit guidance, editorial portraits, and portfolio-ready selects.

services.title: Drone Shoot
services.description: Aerial photography and video that add scale and cinematic perspective to venues, outdoor celebrations, properties, and destinations.
services.deliverables: Aerial establishing shots, venue perspectives, cinematic clips, and coordinated ground-and-air storytelling.
